name: print-social-target-group-flyer-purple-duotone-market-shelf
title: 'Creative solutions to digital challenges' flyer with a purple duotone market shelf photo and chevron list
whatItIs: A purple square flyer with an angled duotone photo of a striped-awning market shelf stocked with fruit and bottles, a thumbs-up icon, a bold three-colour headline ('Creative solutions to digital challenges'), a chevron-marked 'Marketing Professionals' line, and an @-symbol logo with social icons.
whatItMeans: Clean and confident; duotone photography lets a literal product shelf double as an abstract marketing metaphor.
techniques: Duotone a real photo in the brand's single accent colour.
Split a headline across three text weights and colours.
Mark a supporting line with chevron arrows for direction.

vocabulary.definition: A photo rendered using only two colours.
A small arrow symbol used to lead into text.
